hero.title: Data Scientist & AI/ML Engineer
hero.tagline: Final-year engineering student at ENSI, I build data science and AI systems — models, RAG pipelines, agents — and I know how to ship them: APIs, Docker, AWS, CI/CD and security.

about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a final-year engineering student at ENSI (École Nationale des Sciences de l'Informatique, Tunis) since September 2024. Before that, I completed two years of preparatory classes in mathematics at the Faculty of Sciences of Sfax, ranking 110th out of 1800.
about.p2: My core is data science and AI/ML: models, NLP, LLMs, RAG and autonomous agents. On top of that I bring real backend and cloud experience (FastAPI, AWS, Docker, CI/CD, security) to ship systems that are reliable, traceable and deployable, not just prototypes.
about.p3: Remote internships in France and AIESEC volunteering in Romania and Turkey taught me to work autonomously and in multicultural environments.

yonnovia.description: Designed an AI copilot that generates reliable, traceable sales quotes from sales history and CRM data. Integrated with an Odoo ERP, exposed through a FastAPI REST API, deployed on AWS (EC2, S3, IAM), with an MCP interface for interoperability with external AI agents.

lorraine.description: Built a 3D digital twin of an operator from monocular motion capture (Blender), ran musculoskeletal analysis in OpenSim and prepared the integration into MuJoCo/MyoSuite to train an exoskeleton controller with reinforcement learning, using two isolated Docker environments.

fogits.description: Automated LinkedIn lead collection with a Python scraper (Selenium + BeautifulSoup) that processed more than 800 profiles, fed directly into an Odoo ERP (PostgreSQL).

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Data & AI projects first, complemented by backend and security projects that show I can also build robust production systems. Click a card for details, screenshots and the demo.

copilote-devis.title: AI Sales Quote Copilot
copilote-devis.tagline: Reliable, traceable quotes integrated with the Odoo ERP
copilote-devis.description: Designed an AI copilot that generates reliable, traceable sales quotes from sales history and CRM data. Integrated with an Odoo ERP, exposed through a FastAPI REST API, deployed on AWS (EC2, S3, IAM), with an MCP interface for interoperability with external AI agents.

jumeau-numerique-exosquelette.title: 3D Digital Twin & Exoskeleton
jumeau-numerique-exosquelette.tagline: From monocular motion capture to an exoskeleton controller
jumeau-numerique-exosquelette.description: Built a 3D digital twin of an operator from monocular motion capture (Blender), ran musculoskeletal analysis in OpenSim and prepared the integration into MuJoCo/MyoSuite to train an exoskeleton controller with reinforcement learning, using two isolated Docker environments. Automated validation pipeline: anomaly rate reduced from 30% to 0%.

financial-inclusion.title: Financial Inclusion Platform
financial-inclusion.tagline: Digital tontine for collective savings in rural areas
financial-inclusion.description: A digital tontine platform for collective savings in rural areas: it manages contribution cycles and the rotating payout, through a secure REST API (Django REST, JWT) and simulated mobile money contributions. Built in 48 hours, it won 1st Prize at the ACCEDE Internationale international hackathon.

ai-emergency-savior.title: AI Emergency Savior
ai-emergency-savior.tagline: From the patient's voice to the right emergency care provider
ai-emergency-savior.description: An NLP pipeline (LoRA fine-tuning of Whisper) that classifies spoken symptoms with an ICD-10 / SNOMED CT mapping, coupled with a multi-objective optimization engine (NSGA-II) that recommends an emergency care provider under several real-time constraints. Demo deployed on Hugging Face Spaces.

genai-rag-agent.title: GenAI Pipeline & Industrial RAG System
genai-rag-agent.tagline: End-to-end RAG driven by an autonomous AI agent on a local LLM
genai-rag-agent.description: A complete RAG system (FAISS vector store) with prompt engineering and LLM-as-judge evaluation, orchestrated by an autonomous AI agent (LangGraph, ReAct) running on a local LLM.

microservices-cicd.title: Microservices API with CI/CD
microservices-cicd.description: Split a monolithic service into FastAPI microservices communicating through Redis, orchestrated with Docker Compose and delivered by a CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions).

secure-transaction-api.title: Secure Financial Transaction API
secure-transaction-api.description: A secure API (JWT authentication, encryption, GDPR-compliant endpoints) with asynchronous processing of transaction batches (Celery) and logging.

sales-forecasting.title: Sales Forecasting with Time Series
sales-forecasting.description: Exploratory data analysis (EDA) and time-series modeling with Prophet to anticipate demand by capturing trend and seasonality, evaluated with MAE and RMSE.

llm-ticket-classification.title: LLM Fine-tuning for Ticket Classification
llm-ticket-classification.tagline: Detecting the intent of support tickets
llm-ticket-classification.description: Fine-tuned an open-source LLM with PEFT to classify support ticket intent, with MLflow experiment tracking and quantization (GGUF) for local inference.

hackathons.winText: In 48 hours, my team built a digital tontine platform for collective savings in rural areas: contribution cycles, rotating payout, a secure REST API (Django REST, JWT) and simulated mobile money contributions.
